targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_repositories), 0) as total FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote});
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(active_repositories), 0) as active FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote});
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(unique_contributors), 0) as contributors FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote});
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_commits), 0) as commits FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote});
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_prs_merged), 0) as merged FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote});
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(critical_vulnerabilities), 0) as critical FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote});

SELECT service, total_repositories, active_repositories, unique_contributors, total_commits, total_prs_merged, critical_vulnerabilities, ROUND(avg_test_coverage::numeric, 1) as test_coverage_pct, ROUND(avg_pr_review_time_hours::numeric, 1) as avg_pr_review_hrs FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) ORDER BY service;

panels.description: Latest-period snapshot for each service. **Active Repos** — repos with ≥1 commit in the period (red=0, yellow=1–2, green≥3). **Critical Vulns** — critical severity vulnerabilities (green=0, yellow=1–2, red≥3). **Test Coverage** — average across repos (red<50%, yellow 50–79%, green≥80%). **Avg PR Review** — mean open-to-merge time (green<4 h, yellow 4–24 h, red≥24 h).
panels.title: Services at a Glance

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, service, commits FROM v_service_metrics_trend WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time, service;
SELECT time, service, prs_created as created FROM v_service_metrics_trend WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time, service;
SELECT time, service, prs_merged as merged FROM v_service_metrics_trend WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time, service;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_test_coverage)::numeric, 1) as coverage FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) AND avg_test_coverage IS NOT NULL;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_maintainability_index)::numeric, 1) as maintainability FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) AND avg_maintainability_index IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_quality_issues), 0) as issues FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote});
SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_pr_review_time_hours)::numeric, 1) as review_hours FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) AND avg_pr_review_time_hours IS NOT NULL;
SELECT time, service, coverage FROM v_service_metrics_trend WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) AND coverage IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time, service;
SELECT time, service, maintainability FROM v_service_metrics_trend WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) AND maintainability IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time, service;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(critical_vulnerabilities), 0) as critical FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote});
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(high_vulnerabilities), 0) as high FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote});
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(eol_dependencies), 0) as eol FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote});
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_dependencies), 0) as total FROM v_service_metrics_latest WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote});

SELECT severity, SUM(count) as count FROM v_service_vulnerabilities_by_severity WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) GROUP BY severity ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END;
SELECT time, service, vulnerabilities FROM v_service_metrics_trend WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time, service;
SELECT time, service, critical FROM v_service_metrics_trend WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time, service;

SELECT repo_id, repository, service, commits_30d, contributors_30d, open_prs, merged_prs_30d, vulnerabilities, last_analyzed_at FROM v_service_repository_breakdown WHERE service IN (${service:singlequote}) ORDER BY commits_30d DESC;
